scope: finite development screen, not method significance or fullset eligibility
reference: choose no new recipe if neither E1 nor E2 is non-degrading versus corrected Temporal and E0 in each domain mean vIoU, with at least one strictly positive domain evidence gain; numerical equality tolerance1e-6 pp
updater: retain response-guided E1 only if its E1-E2 mean is positive in both domains; otherwise prefer simpler E2 if evidence eligibility holds; if neither eligible stop this specific modification
case_policy: all32, including no-reference/no-update and unknown; no per-query or per-domain recipe switching
confirmation: eligible recipe freezes once before same fixed64; previous project exposure disclosed; no tuning there
cross_backbone: qualification only after viable shared evidence recipe and actual available compatible interface; no new backbone download
